headline: Anthropic files its IPO prospectus, revealing finances, risks and strategy
summary: Anthropic has publicly filed an S-1 prospectus with the SEC ahead of a stock market listing that could value the company as high as $2 trillion. The filing discloses revenue, losses, enterprise customer trends, energy use and risk factors, including warnings about catastrophic AI risk, though some outlets say it omits key financial figures.
